delivery: Unreleased incremental source work. No version bump, commit, push, installer or installation.
scope: Select one generated recipe actor by stable placementId and local actorKey, then set only its changed position, size, color, speed, controls or imageResourceId.

Independent optional Rust patch capability performs strict input/output expansion and byte-preserving patches. Existing source tokens, BOM, line endings, other placements, fragments and identity/group declarations remain intact.
Portable proposal preparation binds saved/current-draft previews to exact source hashes and save baselines, then independently recomputes the receipt before application.
Current source-editor instance override dialog provides named registered image selection, pre-offset local coordinates, complete-source review and Chinese/English/Japanese controls.

Candidate checking validates the full saved dependencies and images through a separate preview lease. Application changes editor memory only; ordinary Save keeps its original external-conflict preconditions.

nativeBuilds.actualArchiveMobileAndGodotTests: Included in final app with supplied real binaries; zero skipped tests.

productFixes: Real browser verification found an empty image picker because the parent controller read payload.projection.resources while /api/world returns projection directly. The controller and regression fixture now read payload.resources.
The override dialog reuses existing responsive form and raw-source review styles so long JSON and identities do not force 390px Chinese/English/Japanese forms beyond the dialog width.
Successful application resets dialog busy state and restores focus through the original host receipt; unchanged form signatures and session tokens prevent stale approval from being reused.
harnessCorrections: Initial parent fixture lacked PROJECT_BUILD_API_PATH; the production module was unchanged for that correction. Initial bridge attempt log is retained.
Initial clean-host assertion expected a dirty-only draft snapshot from a clean editor. It now reads the production state baseline; initial host attempt log is retained.

First prepared mobile resources predated final bridge strict-return expansion validation. Integrity checks correctly rejected them; first retry and final reports preserve subsequent frozen-source checks.

After the image catalog correction, the browser reached the real save-conflict overlay but its script incorrectly tested native dialog.open. The existing overlay uses is-hidden; final six-step run uses that visibility contract. Both failed browser attempts are preserved.
limits: Set-only editing for six fields in one currently opened registered recipe source session. No reset-to-inheritance, override deletion, shared-template editing, definition/identity/group changes, placement-offset edits or canvas dragging.
Only recipe source is overlaid in memory. Dependencies and media are saved versions checked during candidate preview; local application is not an atomic dependency commit.
Recipes remain preview inputs and ordinary documents; they do not become executable build snapshots or generated-scene write grants.
Existing 128 KiB source, 32 fragments, 128 placements, 128 generated actors and Scene2D v3 budgets remain. No nested/cross-file fragment authoring or multi-file transaction.
The preview, override form and ordinary source editor do not provide unified undo history.
Prepared mobile semantic execution on Linux is not Android UI/device acceptance. This round does not open an installed Tauri window or create/install a release.
